# Sandane Homes
> Premium Serviced Apartments & Stays in Gurgaon (Gurugram), Greater Noida, and Noida.

## About Us
Sandane Homes provides luxury serviced apartments, villas, and premium corporate expat accommodations. We blend the comforts of a home with the professional hospitality of a hotel.

## Key Services
- Short-Stay & Serviced Residences
- Luxury Serviced Apartments for Long Stays
- Corporate Housing & Expat Relocations
- Pet-Friendly Stays
- Multi-cuisine In-House Dining & Gourmet Catering
- Secure On-Site Parking & Free Wi-Fi

## Primary Locations
- Near India Expo Centre & Mart, Greater Noida (1.5 km away)
- Near Knowledge Park-II Metro Station
- Near Pari Chowk
- Near Sharda University & Galgotias University
